conclusion: Source-bound revalidation of first-layer native brim ownership, process-width normalization and ordered support splicing after interface planning changes. Test2 retains six closed 0.42 mm Brim loops, 0.42 mm Support and 0.408 mm Support interface at the bed, with no independent submillimetre bed extrusions. The actual 0.17 mm contacts and model geometry remain unchanged. Interface cleanup is separate from brim ownership and only removes generic compact islands without actual support demand.
scope: Reviewed native interface continuity and source-bound test2 Release outputs as of 2026-10-25; historical evidence keeps its original anchors.
